title: Don't Say "Goodbye" – Say This Instead #shorts
description:
Don't say "Goodbye". Say this instead:
• See you later. (with friends)
• Take care. (warm)
• Catch you later. (casual)
• Have a good one. (in shops, American)
• Talk soon. (in messages)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
